turns: How many days of annual leave do I get per year?

gold.reference: As a full-time employee you get 25 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

turns: As a part-timer, how many vacation days am I entitled to?

gold.reference: Part-time employees get annual leave pro-rata to FTE; at 0.6 FTE that is 15 days per year.

turns: Can I carry over unused vacation days to next year?

gold.reference: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over and must be used by 31 March, otherwise they are forfeited.

turns: How much notice do I need to give for a week of vacation?

gold.reference: Requests of more than 3 working days must be submitted at least 10 calendar days before the leave starts.

turns: How many paid sick days do we have?

gold.reference: Employees have 15 paid sick days per calendar year at 100% of salary; after that statutory sickness benefit applies.

turns: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?

gold.reference: You can self-certify up to 3 consecutive working days; from the 4th working day a doctor's note is required within 5 working days.

turns: Can I take sick days to look after my sick kid?

gold.reference: Yes, up to 5 paid sick days per year can be used to care for a sick child under 14.

turns: My father passed away. How much bereavement leave do I get?

gold.reference: For an immediate family member such as a parent you get 5 paid working days of bereavement leave.

turns: Is there any paid leave for exams?

gold.reference: After probation you get 5 paid study leave days per year for role-related exams or courses, requested 14 days in advance.

turns: What happens on my first day?

gold.reference: Arrive at reception at 09:30; you get your badge and laptop, IT sets up accounts, and you meet your manager and buddy.

turns: Which trainings are mandatory for new joiners?

gold.reference: Security awareness, data protection (GDPR), and code of conduct, within the first 14 days.

turns: Is there a gym allowance?

gold.reference: Full-time employees get a EUR 400 yearly wellness allowance that covers gym memberships, claimed with a receipt.

turns: How big is my learning budget?

gold.reference: EUR 1,000 per year for courses, certifications, conferences, and books; items above EUR 300 need manager approval.

turns: Does the company contribute to my pension?

gold.reference: In Riga Brightpath contributes 3% of gross salary to a 3rd pillar pension fund if you contribute at least 2%.

turns: How many days a week do I have to come to the office?

gold.reference: At least 2 days per week; Tuesday and Thursday are team days.

turns: Can I work from Spain for three weeks?

gold.reference: Yes, working from an EU country for up to 4 weeks a year is allowed with manager approval, requested 2 weeks ahead.

turns: What's the deadline for submitting expense claims?

gold.reference: Within 60 days of the purchase, with a receipt.

turns: What is the hotel limit per night when I travel to Lisbon?

gold.reference: EUR 150 per night in Riga and Lisbon.

turns: When is salary paid?

gold.reference: On the 25th of each month, or the previous working day if the 25th is not a working day.

turns: How do I change my bank account details?

gold.reference: Update it in the HR portal within 5 working days; changes after the 15th apply from next month's salary.

turns: Is there free counselling or therapy available?

gold.reference: Yes, the employee assistance programme gives up to 6 free counselling sessions per year.

turns: Do we get a meal allowance?

gold.reference: In Lisbon you get EUR 10.20 per working day on a meal card.

turns: I need a certificate of employment for my bank, how do I get one?

gold.reference: Request it in the HR portal; HR issues it within 3 working days.

turns: My laptop was stolen, what should I do?

gold.reference: Report it to IT Security within 24 hours.

turns: How long is parental leave for the primary caregiver?

gold.reference: The primary caregiver gets 16 weeks (80 working days) of fully paid company parental leave.

turns: Am I eligible for the company health insurance?

gold.reference: No. Contractors are not eligible for company benefits, including health insurance.
